source.content: public class AsyncSaveProbe implements DataSource.AsyncSaveCallback { public static Integer calls = 0; public static Id lastId; public void processSave(Database.SaveResult result) { calls++; if (result != null) { lastId = result.getId(); } } }

public class AsyncDeleteProbe implements DataSource.AsyncDeleteCallback { public static Integer calls = 0; public static Id lastId; public void processDelete(Database.DeleteResult result) { calls++; if (result != null) { lastId = result.getId(); } } }

@isTest private class AsyncDataSourceCallbackContractsTest { @isTest static void callbacksReceiveLocalResults() { AsyncSaveProbe saveCallback = new AsyncSaveProbe(); Account inserted = new Account(Name = 'callback insert'); Database.SaveResult insertResult = Database.insertAsync(inserted, saveCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(insertResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, AsyncSaveProbe.calls); System.assertEquals(insertResult.getId(), AsyncSaveProbe.lastId); Database.SaveResult bareInsertResult = Database.insertAsync(new Account(Name = 'callback bare insert'), saveCallback); System.assert(bareInsertResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(2, AsyncSaveProbe.calls); System.assertEquals(bareInsertResult.getId(), AsyncSaveProbe.lastId); Account updateRecord = new Account(Id = insertResult.getId(), Name = 'callback update'); Database.SaveResult updateResult = Database.updateAsync(updateRecord, saveCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(updateResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(3, AsyncSaveProbe.calls); AsyncDeleteProbe deleteCallback = new AsyncDeleteProbe(); Database.DeleteResult deleteResult = Database.deleteAsync(updateRecord, deleteCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(deleteResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, AsyncDeleteProbe.calls); System.assertEquals(deleteResult.getId(), AsyncDeleteProbe.lastId); } }
